data.one_liner: Comic-inspired Flutter widget set with crisp outlines, hard shadows, and bundled typography.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive collection of comic-styled Flutter UI components, including custom buttons, inputs, dialogs, app bars, and bottom navigation. It features built-in dark mode support, local theme overrides, and accessibility features.
use_when: Building a mobile application with a distinct comic book or graphic novel aesthetic
Needing out-of-the-box accessible widgets with hard shadows and crisp outlines
Wanting a custom design system without relying on standard Material Design elevations
avoid_when: Your application requires a standard Material or Cupertino look and feel
You need standard platform-native UI components without custom stylings
strengths: Distinctive and complete comic-inspired widget library
Built-in accessibility, RTL support, and keyboard focus
Comprehensive dark mode tokens and local overrides
weaknesses: Locked into a very specific visual style which may not fit all apps
Limited to Android and iOS platforms
data.setup_notes: No additional font setup is needed as Short Stack is bundled locally.
